profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Nava PBC | Building technology that makes government services accessible to all
profile.summary:
I’ve spent my career asking one question: how can technology expand our circle of compassion?

I grew up roaming the corridors of my city hall and directing 2,000 fellow high school students in a city re-envisioning process. That early belief that civic participation matters has shaped everything since — from running operations at a public health nonprofit, to building legislative software for governments, to where I am today: helping Veterans access their disability benefits faster at the VA with Nava PBC.

At Nava, I work as a Senior Software Engineer on a team dedicated to making government services simple, effective, and accessible to all. I’m most energized when the tools I build have a direct, positive impact on real people’s lives — and I’ve been lucky to find that through civic tech.

My background spans full-stack and backend engineering across Ruby, JavaScript, Elixir, Python, and more, with deep experience in Rails, React, and PostgreSQL. I bring a collaborative, big-picture perspective and a strong commitment to agile, test-driven development.

Outside of work, I’m a community organizer at heart who believes good tools give people more time for what matters most.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contribute to modernizing how Veterans access disability benefits, reducing friction in a high-stakes process that directly affects people’s lives.

Build and maintain features on a mission-driven team committed to making government services simple, effective, and accessible.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Returned briefly before transitioning to pursue long-held goal of working in public interest technology.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered features for a mobile platform improving school-family communication, including automatic language translation, scheduling, and messaging tools

Expanded access for families across language barriers and activity types

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description: Developed backend features enabling thousands of community teams and organizations to coordinate with less administrative overhead

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built citizen-facing legislative and agenda management applications for local, state, and federal governments

Coordinated a recurring knowledge-sharing series for 90+ engineers covering Kafka, Kubernetes, machine learning, blockchain, and AI

positions.title: Chief Operating Officer
positions.description:
Directed all operations for a public health nonprofit with 2M+ monthly site visits

Grew annual donations 82% to over $500K through improved donor relations and outreach automation

Scaled volunteer support to resolve 10,000+ tickets/year via ZenDesk implementation

Grew Facebook audience 285% to 412,000 followers through strategic content planning

Supported 62% increase in site traffic by coordinating accessibility and mobile-readiness improvements

Managed 10–30 researchers and coordinated thousands of remote volunteers

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description: I was humbled to work alongside other volunteers reforesting land and learning about living a sustainable life.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Political Science: Environmental Politics and Political Theory

honors.title: Fulbright U.S. Student Alternate, Public Health, Bangladesh
honors.description: The Fulbright Program selected me as an Alternate for a scholarship in Public Health for Bangladesh in 2014. My research proposed reducing the risk of rabies infection by dogs and humans through community-led immunocontraceptive sterilization and rabies vaccination of free-roaming dogs.

honors.title: Graduate Teaching Assistantship scholarship (Fall 2009- Spring 2011)
honors.issuer: Issued by Colorado State University · Aug 2009

volunteerExperiences.description: I helped United Way of Greater Milwaukee and Waukesha County develop a solution for tracking and delivering urgent needs like PPE and childcare supplies across the region. Using a platform developed by the US Digital Response team, I built out and customized an Airtable back-end form and workflow and provided training for coordinators and partner organizations.

volunteerExperiences.role: Secretary of the Board of Directors
volunteerExperiences.description: Riverwest Food Co-op's mission is to provide nutritious, wholesome food to the Riverwest community at fair prices. Pre-pandemic I volunteered 3 hours weekly in the store. I also draft and send out the Co-op's monthly email newsletter. I believe in its mission of supporting local agriculture, organic farming, and environmental sustainability by sharing healthful foods with the neighborhood.
